title: Metashape workflows and connector status
description: Explore Metashape workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

SoftwareUpcoming

Agisoft

Metashape

Agisoft Metashape supports photogrammetric reconstruction, orthomosaics and measurement products from imagery.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Align source photographs

Start from the selected scans, photographs or measured geometry and coordinate basis. In the intended Metashape preview, align source photographs; the visible result is an aligned capture set with coverage and registration state visible. Review scale, overlap, control points and residual error before accepting or exporting it.

Build a dense model

Begin with the cleaned capture and nominal reference. In the intended Metashape preview, build a dense model; the visible result is a segmented, reconstructed or compared geometry result. Review noise, holes, alignment strategy and tolerance basis before accepting or exporting it.

Generate an orthomosaic and report

Use the reviewed mesh, surface, cloud or inspection characteristics. In the intended Metashape preview, generate an orthomosaic and report; the visible result is an export or report tied to the captured source and coordinate system. Review deviation limits, completeness, units and downstream fitness before accepting or exporting it.
